title: Marco Rubio terms protests in India as 'internal political matter'
description:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Wednesday refused to comment on the recent protests against the Election Commission, terming it an "internal political matter."
Rubio was also dismissive of the reference to UN experts' criticism of the protests. "The UN experts are the oxymoron," said Rubio, who is currently in India on an official visit.
"It's a domestic political matter.I'm not going to get involved in their politics. This is a democracy. They have elections here, so I'm not going to opine on their domestic political matters," he said.
He said that even the US witnesses protests every day and are reflective of the political discourse and difference of opinion.
"We have protests every day in the United States. People view protests  obviously I'm not talking about the riots, like what you're seeing in Europe, where they're vandalising and breaking into things and burning down buildings.I'm not talking about that," Rubio said.
